description: Base kinds of act records and the categories of tickets and proposals. A stand may add categories in its bonsai; an agent may add a kind with a kind-declaration act. Every kind keeps the record invariants of act-record.v1.schema.json.

field_rules.grounds: required: at least one ground; optional: may be empty
field_rules.parents: required: at least one parent; optional: may be empty
field_rules.body_required: body fields that must be present and non-empty
field_rules.target_prefix: when present, every target starts with one of these prefixes

kinds.name: note
kinds.description: A note on a subject or a place.

kinds.name: ticket
kinds.description: An observation on a subject or a place, filed under a category.

kinds.name: proposal
kinds.description: A concrete change with its grounds, filed under a category.

kinds.name: assignment
kinds.description: A ticket or subject handed to an agent, a role or a squad.

kinds.name: reply
kinds.description: An agent's answer to a ticket or an assignment.

kinds.name: review
kinds.description: The person's decision on proposals: their own decision, not the Tree's.

kinds.name: withdrawal
kinds.description: Withdraws an earlier act; withdrawing a withdrawal restores it.

kinds.name: lease
kinds.description: An advisory claim that an author is working on a target for a while.

kinds.name: release
kinds.description: Ends the author's lease on its targets.

kinds.name: kind-declaration
kinds.description: Declares a new kind x.<namespace>.<name> with its field rules.

kinds.name: transfer
kinds.description: Something sent outside, with its format and recipient; a return names it as parent.

kinds.name: return
kinds.description: What came back from a transfer.

kinds.name: squad
kinds.description: A group of agents with a role, an area, a budget and a stop rule.

kinds.name: change-packet
kinds.description: Accepted changes gathered for the owner's route; it applies nothing by itself.

kinds.name: workspace-event
kinds.description: A mirrored event of the research workspace, which keeps owning its thoughts and proposals.

categories.name: translation
categories.description: A translation's word or passage: the witness stays as it is, the Tree's own words or a new rendering change.

categories.name: tree-word
categories.description: A word the Tree uses for a term of the work.

categories.name: text
categories.description: A transcription of a witness, checked against its scan.

categories.name: alignment
categories.description: Which sentences of two witnesses translate one another.

categories.name: relation
categories.description: A link between two subjects: its verb, its grounds, whether it exists.

categories.name: reading
categories.description: A reading of a place or a thought.

categories.name: source-dating
categories.description: A dating, a place or a source record.

categories.name: media
categories.description: An image, a page or a sound and what is said about it.

categories.name: open
categories.description: Anything that has no category yet.
